label: Plan Event
notes: PlanEvent carries two required slots (name string, effective_at datetime/RFC3339), an optional number (confidence), and a dotted-name enum slot (source.priority). The dot in 'source.priority' is treated as a flat slot key, consistent with core-v1.json which lists it as a single attribute name; whether it denotes a nested object is design-intent (see M2-time.md open questions). effect_types is a type-level descriptor on PlanEvent, not a slot; it enumerates the Plan Event effect operations and mirrors the plan_effect relationship's op enum.
